name: opensrcer
description: A contribution harness for open source: each project's unwritten rules (what gets merged, why PRs get closed, what reviewers ask for) in your agent's context, a workflow that proves the fix, and your contributions counted on opensrcer.

opensrcer_token.title: opensrcer token
opensrcer_token.description: From https://opensrced.vercel.app/account (Harness → Create token). Starts with osh_.

map_size.title: Code map size
map_size.description: How tall the code map above the prompt is: small, medium, large or extra large. hidden: only /opensrcer-map opens it (e.g. when the opensrcer VS Code extension shows the map in a tab beside your editor).
